### FileSource

```ts
type FileSource = Readonly<{
  list: Promise<Readonly<{
    path: string;
    entries: readonly FileEntry[];
    nextOffset: number | null;
  }> | null>;
  read: Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> | null>;
  write: Promise<void>;
  mkdir: Promise<void>;
  replace: Promise<FileReplaceOutcome>;
}>;
```

Where an Oyster's files live. Paths are absolute (`/notes/a.md`) and already
normalized by the routes; a source never sees `..`.
